## Continuum 0.5.10

### Phone Mirroring, sharper and steadier
- **Mirroring no longer stops while YouTube (or another video app) plays a video.** Android takes the phone's video hardware away from Continuum when the app on screen needs it. Continuum now carries on with a smaller encoder, then goes back to full quality when it can.
- **Sharper picture:** the full screen resolution your phone can encode at 60 fps, and a much higher bitrate (up to 50 Mbit/s on a fast local network). It still lowers itself for a moment if the Wi-Fi gets busy.
- **Less lag:** Wi-Fi power saving is paused while mirroring, so frames no longer arrive in bursts, and encoding runs at display priority. On Qualcomm phones, the encoder's own low-latency mode is on.

Update both the computer and the phone to get all of this.

Google Play Protect may ask to scan the app, because it isn't from the Play Store. Tap **Scan app**, then **Install**.
